gift.subtitle: Share the Sweetness
gift.desc1: Whether it's a birthday, an anniversary, or a simple "thinking of you", a From Scratch gift card is the perfect way to share the warmth of our ovens with the people you care about.
gift.desc2: Redeemable for any of our fresh artisan pastries, signature boba teas, or seasonal specials in-store. Treat someone special to a moment of delight, baked fresh daily.

story.p1: On April 15, 2024, From Scratch Bakeshop & Boba opened as an Asian-inspired bakery, created to bring those comforting flavours to the North. Everything we make is prepared from scratch in our kitchen, using thoughtfully sourced ingredients and time-honoured techniques—because in a place where seasons are long and days can be cold, care and patience matter.
story.p2: Here, baking is more than food. It's warmth on a winter morning, a familiar taste after a long day, and a small moment of comfort shared with others. From Scratch is our way of contributing to the North—offering something honest, handmade, and comforting, one bun and one pastry at a time.
